anomalies: flavor: Space is full of wonders and secrets hiding among the stars, just waiting to be found. You want to see it all.
desc: - 2 Glory for every spatial anomaly you discover.
- 4 Glory for every anomaly the Daedalus visits.
artifacts: flavor: As an intergalactic explorer, your dream is to amass a vast hoard of alien artifacts... and keep them to yourself, obviously!
desc: - 2 Glory for each alien artifact found by the crew.
astronomer: flavor: You have devoted your life to discovering and exploring new worlds, and now you must do so to ensure the survival of humanity!
desc: - 2 Glory for every planet you discover.
- 1 Glory for entering orbit of a new planet.
botanist: flavor: They might be concerned with the fauna, but your dream is to grow your own exotic garden full of alien fruit!
desc: - 3 Glory for each Alien Fruit you plant.
capricious: flavor: You just want to have fun, and you want to do it your way. When you get a capricious urge, you need to act on it!
desc: - 3 Glory for every successfully completed Capricious objective.
chef: flavor: You want to put the 'art' back in 'culinary arts'! Too bad availability of quality ingredients is limited here.
desc: - 2 Glory for each premium food you successfully cook.
commander: flavor: As first in line for the crew's leadership, you must direct the ship and its occupants towards a brighter future!
desc: - 3 Glory for every planet the Daedalus reaches.
- 8 Glory for leading the crew to Eden.
conqueror: flavor: You've been given a golden opportunity to explore the stars and conquer many worlds. You will leave your mark on this universe.
desc: - 4 Glory for every planet fully explored.
craftsman: flavor: Surrounded by all this advanced technology, you must prove that there's nothing you can't understand the inner workings of. You'll be the one to build it all.
desc: - 2 Glory for every blueprint you build or item you craft.
dangerous: flavor: You are a force to be reckoned with! You just need to prove your skills in hand-to-hand combat. And surely the crew will respect you with a title or two.
desc: - 2 Glory for each Fight event you encounter on an expedition.
- 4 Glory the first time you earn each Title.
defender: flavor: Your mission is to protect the crew from invaders. If any hostile life-forms come aboard, you're the first one on call to dispatch them.
desc: - 3 Glory for every hostile alien killed.
designer: flavor: You are intimately familiar with the design of this ship, and nothing would be more fulfilling than to see it reach its maximum potential.
desc: - 2 Glory for every NERON project installed.
diplomat: flavor: Your goal is to reach out to and study new forms of alien life, even if said life is trying to kill you...
desc: - 2 Glory for every encounter with alien life-forms.
drones: flavor: Your drones are the cutting edge of technology, but science is always striving to be even better. Your goal is to help your drones reach their peak!
desc: - 4 Glory each time you upgrade a Drone.
explorer: flavor: You are the most eager to lead expeditions to new worlds, and reap the bounties (and glory) they provide.
desc: - 3 Glory for each expedition you embark upon.
fortunes: flavor: Not many people believe you can speak with the dead and draw wisdom from the stars. You will prove it by telling their fortunes and showing them the truth!
desc: - 2 Glory each time you tell someone's fortune. Earn 3 instead if you successfully predict a positive or negative outcome.
generic: flavor: You're just happy to be here! Stay alive and don't do anything stupid!
desc: - No extra glory earned from objectives.
healer: flavor: Your life's goal is to spread kindness and goodwill to all good-hearted life-forms. You will restore their bodies, minds, and spirits.
desc: - 2 Glory for every illness or injury you cure.
hunter: flavor: Nothing gets the juices flowing better than sitting in the cockpit of a patroller and gunning down hostiles with your mad skills.
desc: - 1 Glory for every 2 Hunters you kill.
lover: flavor: Science, exploration, bah, none of that matters if you can't hook up with some hotties along the way. You'll win them over with your good looks and your charm or die trying!
desc: - 2 Glory each time someone you have flirted with flirts back.
- 2 Glory each time you Do The Thing.
moh: flavor: You are the last hope for humanity! Your goal is to stay alive and help complete research that requires your presence.
desc: - 1 Glory for every day you have survived.
- 4 Glory for each research project that requires your presence.
mush_cure: flavor: Your life's work has been to find the cure to the Mush parasite. It can be reversed, they don't have to die!
desc: - 5 Glory for completing Retro-Fungal Serum.
- 5 Glory if a Mush agent is successfully cured.
mush_hunter: flavor: Those dirty mushrooms, on YOUR precious ship?! Inconceivable! You must eliminate them as quickly as possible!
desc: - 3 Glory for every Mush agent killed.
mush_research: flavor: As one of the most brilliant minds aboard this ship, you must spearhead the research against the Mush and prevent them from taking over.
desc: - 3 Glory for every anti-Mush research completed.
pilgred: flavor: The PILGRED reactor is your baby, and you are the most qualified to repair it. All of this will be for nothing if you can't get out of deep space!
desc: - 2 Glory for every PILGRED repair completed.
psychopath: flavor: You're a bit too eager to murder things, and that is your objective. Just try not to kill something others will miss.
desc: - 2 Glory for every living thing you kill.
rebel: flavor: You are not alone in your fight against the Mush! Your top priority is to contact the rebel bases and enlist the aid of their knowledge and resources.
desc: - 2 Glory for each Rebel transmission decoded.
shipshape: flavor: You built this ship, and it's up to you to prove that your work is not a pile of space junk. What they don't know won't hurt them...
desc: - 2 Glory for every 20 Hull Points repaired.
- 1 Glory every cycle the ship spends above 90 hull (from day 2 onwards).
trader: flavor: You're a person of many talents, but nothing speaks to you more than the universal language of business. Your goal is to conduct trades with aliens!
desc: - 4 Glory for each successful trade made with alien ships.
xeno_research: flavor: There is no shortage of things to learn about alien races. Your objective is to study them and find every useful application of their biology.
desc: - 2 Glory for every completed Xenobiologist research.
xyloph: flavor: You are the head of communications aboard this ship, but your primary goal is to contact Xyloph and reunite with Kivanc Terzi.
desc: - 8 Glory for contacting Kivanc Terzi through Xyloph.
xyloph2: flavor: You are the head of communications aboard this ship, but your primary goal is to contact Xyloph and reunite with Paola Rinaldo.
desc: - 8 Glory for contacting Paola Rinaldo through Xyloph.
